license_required.quote: After the passage of this Article it shall be unlawful for any person to practice optometry in the State unless he has first obtained a certificate of registration as hereinafter provided.

issuing_authority.value: North Carolina State Board of Examiners in Optometry
issuing_authority.quote: The North Carolina State Board of Examiners in Optometry shall grant licenses to practice optometry to such applicants

name.value: North Carolina State Board of Examiners in Optometry
name.quote: In order to properly regulate the practice of optometry, there is established a North Carolina State Board of Examiners in Optometry

type.quote: North Carolina State Board of Examiners in Optometry, which shall consist of five regularly graduated optometrists

age_minimum.quote: The applicant shall be of good moral character and at least 18 years of age at the time the application for examination is filed.

moral_character_required.quote: The applicant shall be of good moral character

degree_required.value: graduate of an accredited optometric institution
degree_required.quote: graduates of an accredited optometric institution

accrediting_body.value: accredited optometric college or the optometric department of an accredited university or college recognized and approved by the Board
accrediting_body.quote: he is a graduate of and has a diploma from an accredited optometric college or the optometric department of an accredited university or college recognized and approved as such by the said Board

exams.name: Written or oral and clinical examination
exams.quote: The North Carolina State Board of Examiners in Optometry is authorized to conduct both written or oral and clinical examinations of such character as to thoroughly test the qualifications of the applicant

interval_years.quote: On or before December 31 of each year, each optometrist engaged in the practice of optometry in North Carolina shall make application to the North Carolina State Board of Examiners in Optometry and receive from said Board, subject to the further provisions of this section and of this Article, a certificate of renewal of said license.

renewal_fee_usd.quote: Each general optometry license renewal, which fee shall be annually fixed by the Board, and not later than December 15 of each year written notice of the amount of the renewal fee shall be given to each optometrist licensed to practice in this State by mailing the notice to the last address of record with the Board of each such optometrist 500.00

required.quote: All registered optometrists now or hereafter licensed in the State of North Carolina are and shall be required to take annual courses of study in subjects relating to the practice of the profession of optometry

hours_per_period.quote: The length of study shall be prescribed by the Board but shall not exceed 25 hours in any calendar year.

available.quote: If an applicant for licensure is already licensed in another state in optometry, the North Carolina State Board of Examiners in Optometry shall issue a license to practice optometry to the applicant without examination other than a clinical practicum examination

requirements.value: Currently licensed in another state, practiced at least 3 of 5 years preceding application, no pending disciplinary proceedings, licensure requirements in other state equivalent to or higher than NC
requirements.quote: The applicant is currently an active, competent practitioner in good standing, and The applicant has practiced at least three out of the five years immediately preceding his or her application, and The applicant currently holds a valid license in another state, and No disciplinary proceeding or unresolved complaint is pending anywhere at the time a license is to be issued by this State, and The licensure requirements in the other state are equivalent to or higher than those required by this State.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in fraud, deceit or misrepresentation in obtaining or attempting to obtain a license or renewal
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in any act or acts of fraud, deceit or misrepresentation in obtaining or attempting to obtain a license or the renewal thereof

disciplinary_grounds.description: Chronic or persistent user of intoxicants, drugs or narcotics impairing ability to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is a chronic or persistent user of intoxicants, drugs or narcotics to the extent that the same impairs his ability to practice optometry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted of criminal provisions of the optometry article or entered plea of guilty or nolo contendere
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted of any of the criminal provisions of this Article or has entered a plea of guilty or nolo contendere to any charge or charges arising therefrom

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted of felony or misdemeanor involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted of or entered a plea of guilty or nolo contendere to any felony charge or to any misdemeanor charge involving moral turpitude

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted of violation of state or federal narcotic or barbiturate law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted of or entered a plea of guilty or nolo contendere to any charge of violation of any State or federal narcotic or barbiturate law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in act or practice violative of article provisions or board rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in any act or practice violative of any of the provisions of this Article or violative of any of the rules and regulations promulgated and adopted by the Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unable to practice with reasonable skill and safety due to substance abuse or physical/mental condition
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is unable to practice optometry with reasonable skill and safety by reason of abuse of alcohol, drugs, chemicals, or any other type of substance, or by reason of any physical or mental illness, abnormality, or other limiting condition

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitted use of name, diploma or license by another person in illegal practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has permitted the use of his name, diploma or license by another person either in the illegal practice of optometry or in attempting to fraudulently obtain a license to practice optometry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in immoral conduct discrediting the profession
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in such immoral conduct as to discredit the optometry profession

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtained, collected or attempted to obtain or collect fee through fraud, misrepresentation or deceit
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has obtained or collected or attempted to obtain or collect any fee through fraud, misrepresentation, or deceit

disciplinary_grounds.description: Negligent in the practice of optometry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been negligent in the practice of optometry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employed unlicensed person to perform acts that require licensure
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has employed a person not licensed in this State to do or perform any act of service, or has aided, abetted or assisted any such unlicensed person to do or perform any act or service which under this Article can lawfully be done or performed only by an optometrist licensed in this State

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incompetent in the practice of optometry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is incompetent in the practice of optometry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practiced fraud, deceit or misrepresentation in acquiring or retaining patients, including false advertising
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has practiced any fraud, deceit or misrepresentation upon the public or upon any individual in an effort to acquire or retain any patient or patients, including false or misleading advertising

disciplinary_grounds.description: Made fraudulent or misleading statements about skill, knowledge or method of treatment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has made fraudulent or misleading statements pertaining to his skill, knowledge, or method of treatment or practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committed fraudulent or misleading acts in practice of optometry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has committed any fraudulent or misleading acts in the practice of optometry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committed act or acts constituting malpractice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has, in the practice of optometry, committed an act or acts constituting malpractice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitted optometric assistant to perform acts violative of article or board rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has permitted an optometric assistant in his employ or under his supervision to do or perform any act or acts violative to this Article or of the rules and regulations promulgated by the Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Wrongfully held self out as qualified specialist in branch of optometry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has wrongfully or fraudulently or falsely held himself out to be or represented himself to be qualified as a specialist in any branch of optometry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Persistently maintained unsanitary offices, practices or techniques
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has persistently maintained, in the practice of optometry, unsanitary offices, practices, or techniques

disciplinary_grounds.description: Menace to public health due to serious communicable disease
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is a menace to the public health by reason of having a serious communicable disease

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in unprofessional conduct as defined by board rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in any unprofessional conduct as the same may be from time to time defined by the rules and regulations of the Board

definition_quote.value: Any one or any combination of the following practices shall constitute the practice of optometry: (1) The examination of the human eye by any method, other than surgery, to diagnose, to treat, or to refer for consultation or treatment any abnormal condition of the human eye and its adnexa; or (2) The employment of instruments, devices, pharmaceutical agents and procedures, other than surgery, intended for the purposes of investigating, examining, treating, diagnosing or correcting visual defects or abnormal conditions of the human eye or its adnexa; or (3) The prescribing and application of lenses, devices containing lenses, prisms, contact lenses, orthoptics, vision training, pharmaceutical agents, and prosthetic devices to correct, relieve, or treat defects or abnormal conditions of the human eye or its adnexa.
definition_quote.quote: Any one or any combination of the following practices shall constitute the practice of optometry: (1) The examination of the human eye by any method, other than surgery, to diagnose, to treat, or to refer for consultation or treatment any abnormal condition of the human eye and its adnexa; or (2) The employment of instruments, devices, pharmaceutical agents and procedures, other than surgery, intended for the purposes of investigating, examining, treating, diagnosing or correcting visual defects or abnormal conditions of the human eye or its adnexa; or (3) The prescribing and application of lenses, devices containing lenses, prisms, contact lenses, orthoptics, vision training, pharmaceutical agents, and prosthetic devices to correct, relieve, or treat defects or abnormal conditions of the human eye or its adnexa.

value: diagnosis and treatment of abnormal conditions
methods_authorized.quote: The examination of the human eye by any method, other than surgery, to diagnose, to treat, or to refer for consultation or treatment any abnormal condition of the human eye and its adnexa; or The employment of instruments, devices, pharmaceutical agents and procedures, other than surgery, intended for the purposes of investigating, examining, treating, diagnosing or correcting visual defects or abnormal conditions of the human eye or its adnexa; or The prescribing and application of lenses, devices containing lenses, prisms, contact lenses, orthoptics, vision training, pharmaceutical agents, and prosthetic devices

drug_authority.value: Pharmaceutical agents authorized for diagnosis and treatment of abnormal conditions of the eye and its adnexa, subject to educational requirements and board certification
drug_authority.quote: No optometrist presently licensed in this State shall prescribe and use pharmaceutical agents in the practice of optometry unless and until he (i) has submitted to the Board evidence of satisfactory completion of all educational requirements established by the Board to prescribe and use pharmaceutical agents in the practice of optometry and (ii) has been certified by the Board as educationally qualified to prescribe and use pharmaceutical agents.

surgery_prohibited.quote: The examination of the human eye by any method, other than surgery

vision_therapy_authorized.quote: The prescribing and application of lenses, devices containing lenses, prisms, contact lenses, orthoptics, vision training, pharmaceutical agents, and prosthetic devices

pharmaceutical_certification_required.quote: No optometrist presently licensed in this State shall prescribe and use pharmaceutical agents in the practice of optometry unless and until he (i) has submitted to the Board evidence of satisfactory completion of all educational requirements established by the Board to prescribe and use pharmaceutical agents in the practice of optometry and (ii) has been certified by the Board as educationally qualified to prescribe and use pharmaceutical agents.

contact_lens_prescription_expiration_yea.quote: The prescriber shall state the expiration date on the face of every prescription, and the expiration date shall be no earlier than 365 days after the examination date.

spectacle_prescription_release_required.quote: All persons licensed or registered under this Chapter shall upon request give each patient having received an eye examination a copy of the patient's spectacle prescription

patient_record_retention_years.quote: Prescriptions filled pursuant to this section shall be kept on file by the prescriber and the person filling the prescription for at least 24 months after the prescription is filled.
